evidence.title: README (segment 5)
README (segment 7)
evidence.excerpt: A Rust-native MTG engine compiling to native and WASM, powering a Tauri desktop app, browser PWA, and WebSocket multiplayer. Implements comprehensive MTG rules using functional architecture — pure reducers, discriminated unions, and immutable state with structural sharing — with an Arena-quality React/TypeScript UI.

evidence.title: README (segment 8)
evidence.excerpt: I'm Matt — a millennial software engineer who loves Magic. My six-year-old son asks me to play with him all the time, but the real game is just too complicated for a kid his age.
